title: Decision: Use unchecked_transaction for migration atomicity
description:
In Store::migrate (line 182), migrations use unchecked_transaction() for schema DDL + PRAGMA user_version bump. This is safe and correct because:

1. Each kithd opens exactly one Connection per mailbox (single-writer guarantee)
2. unchecked_transaction avoids the savepoint stack overhead
3. Comment explicitly documents why it's safe
4. Atomicity ensures failed INSERT cannot leave permanent holes in state_version
5. Future Phase 2 concurrent writers would need explicit transaction, but comment flags this

This is a non-obvious optimization that correctly leverages the single-writer constraint.
